name: Build and Test

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: 'The git ref to build'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      version:
        description: 'The version to build (for release)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            npm_arch: x64
            npm_platform: linux
            npm_target: linux-x64-gnu
          - os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            npm_arch: arm64
            npm_platform: darwin
            npm_target: darwin-arm64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.ref }}

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build Rust binary
        run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }}

      - name: Build Node.js native addon
        run: npm run build

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: npm-${{ matrix.npm_target }}
          path: |
            dist/
            package.json
            README.md
            LICENSE
          retention-days: 5

  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.ref }}

      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: npm-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

  bundle:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.ref }}

      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          pattern: npm-*
          path: release-bundle
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Prepare release bundle
        run: |
          cd release-bundle
          # Ensure package.json is present and correct
          if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
            cp ../package.json .
          fi
          # Create tarball for release
          tar -czvf ../release-bundle.tar.gz .

      - name: Upload release bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-bundle
          path: release-bundle.tar.gz
          retention-days: 5
